title: WASD Loading
cue: loading screen and shader warm-up that work in browsers
summary: Scene changes behind a loading screen with a bar that moves, in Web builds too, and every shader compiled before play, so the first explosion or enemy does not stall the game.
useWhen: The game has more than one scene, a level that takes over a second to load, or stalls the first time an effect, an enemy, or a new material shows: a Web build above all, where Godot's background loading freezes the page and each shader compiles the moment it is first drawn.
avoidWhen: The whole game is one small scene that starts at once and shows everything from the first frame.
